exceptions.bounded_reason: No rated easy source template or reliable easy classification evidence. This package supports only observed hard entry-elimination selection. Reopen on new source evidence.
No rated moderate source template or reliable moderate classification evidence. Do not relabel hard instances to fill this band. Reopen on new source evidence.

excluded_sources.reason: Unrated; missing correct designation and worked solution. Preserved unchanged.

source_corrections.evidence: R2 := R2 + (1/2) R3 changes only R2. Source displays third row (2,1,2), but supplied third row is (2,-6,-4). Exact operation yields rows (6,4,8),(3,-2,0),(2,-6,-4).
source_corrections.policy: Correct generated solution; retain original unchanged and exclude it from validated inventory.

finite_sampling_policy: Nine complete source profiles; vary one non-target entry in the queried column by -3..3, preserving nonzero sign and integral supplied entries. If that entry is in the elimination source row, adjust target entry to preserve the source coefficient. Apply all six row and all six column permutations consistently. Reject any bank with multiple or no target-zero choices. Coefficients, five-choice banks, and solution stages retained. Novelty hashes only queried-column values and target role, modulo row relabeling and common nonzero scaling. Other columns, identities, labels, seed, bank, order, and column position never establish novelty.
